page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 server instance equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs, 768.0 GB of system RAM, and four discrete NVIDIA A10 GPUs providing a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. Operating under the KVM hypervisor, the server provides a high-capacity baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Local disk storage is not included with the instance, requiring all persistent storage and swap space to be provisioned through network-attached block storage devices.

The hardware configuration yields a ratio of 6.0 GB of system memory per vCPU alongside 24 GB of VRAM per GPU accelerator. This architecture combines significant parallel x86 CPU compute capacity with multi-GPU hardware acceleration. The lack of onboard local NVMe SSDs introduces storage I/O dependency on network performance, but the 64 Gbps baseline network fabric helps mitigate throughput bottlenecks for remote disk and inter-node communications.

The ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge instance is structured for GPU-intensive workloads. Recommended deployment scenarios include artificial intelligence inference, deep learning neural network training, video encoding and transcoding pipelines, high-performance 3D graphics rendering, and parallel scientific computing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated cloud server instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs, 768.0 GB of system memory, and four NVIDIA A10 GPUs offering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides a memory-to-core ratio of 6.0 GB per vCPU alongside a high-throughput 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth connection. The hardware configuration contains no local NVMe or SSD storage drives, requiring all persistent data and operating system files to reside on external network-attached storage. The hardware architecture balances multi-core x86 CPU performance with discrete GPU memory capacity and fast interconnect speed. The ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge instance is intended for compute-dense workloads, including deep learning model training, artificial intelligence inference, high-performance graphics rendering, video processing, and parallel data analytics.
